name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
summary: Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A. operates internationally, producing and supplying a wide array of fertilizers and chemical goods. Its fertilizer offerings feature ammonium nitrate (marketed as PULAN), the granular Pulan Macro, and urea-ammonium nitrate solutions known as UAN. The company also provides PULSAR brand ammonium sulphate, UAN+S (a urea-ammonium nitrate solution enhanced with sulphur), PULASKA (a nitrogen fertilizer solution containing sulphur), and urea-ammonium sulfate under the PULGRAN S name. In the chemical sector, their products range from COOLANT dry ice, hydrogen peroxide, anhydrous ammonia, compressed hydrogen, liquefied carbon dioxide, and nitric acid – all essential for various industrial chemical processes. They also manufacture caprolactam for industrial solid and liquid formulations, melamine used in synthetic resin production, and LIKAM, an ammonia water solution employed across diverse industries including power generation, tanning, agriculture, rubber, dye, organic, and glass, and as a pH control agent. Furthermore, the firm supplies NOXy, a urea water solution for the automotive industry, and PULNOx, a reducing agent crucial for vehicle emissions control systems. Complementing these are packaging and foil products, including flat open sacks, big bag contributions, colored foils, flat foil belts, FSS foil tape with side folds, garbage bags, garden foils, LDPE, and stretch protective films. Founded in 1960 and based in Pulawy, Poland, Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Grupa Azoty S.A.
